body.description: The project proposes converting the garage into a new ADU (under the state ADU program). The existing water heater will be relocated to the back yard. The furnace will be relocated without altering any of the ducts. A new electric heat pump water heater will be installed in the ADU. A new heating and cooling pump system will also be installed in the ADU. Except for the items mentioned above there will be no vertical changes, no changes in the number of stories, no other additions, remodeling, or alteration are in the scope of work for this project. There will also be no seismic retrofitting, no structural upgrading, and no trees will be removed from the work site.
Per Ordinance 43-14 and Planning Code Section 207.3, the project proposes to legalize an existing dwelling unit.

Convert 1st story basement to finished space. Full 2nd story remodel. Seismic retrofit of entire building. Addition of 250sqft to back of house with deck above for master bedroom meeting PC Section 249.3.
